steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each close item needs a sign-off, each reconciliation must be explained, and each accrual needs a basis.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Accrual with no basis
findings.fix: Give the basis for the accrual

outcome.notChecked: The accuracy of the underlying ledger.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] check-recon-bank.md:12  Reconciliation with an unexplained difference.
       Fix: Explain the difference before close.
[medium] check-signoff.md:19  Item with no sign-off.
       Fix: Get the sign-off.
[low] check-accruals.md:26  Accrual with no basis.
       Fix: Give the basis for the accrual.
Not checked: The accuracy of the underlying ledger.
pros: Checks an item with no sign-off, a reconciliation with an unexplained difference, and an accrual with no basis.
cons: Not checked: The accuracy of the underlying ledger.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-month-end-close skill on the records for this review.
